description:
Run a backtest on a strategy with condition groups against historical data. Returns win rate, PnL, Sharpe ratio, drawdown, trade list, equity curve and per-condition hit counts. Replays on the same evaluator that fires live alerts. condition_groups may be in the strategy shape (left/operator/right) or the screener shape from run_screen (indicatorId/operator/value). Without stop_loss_pct/take_profit_pct a trade closes when the entry conditions stop holding.

PAID TOOL — 0.02 USDC per call, over x402 (eip155:8453). Call it once without payment: the answer carries the exact payment requirements. Sign them and call again with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]. You are charged only when the call succeeds.

commission_pct.description: Round-trip fee in percent subtracted from every trade (defaults to venue standard round-trip rate)

condition_groups.description: Array of condition groups defining the strategy logic. condition_groups must be [{ id, logicOperator: 'AND'|'OR', conditions: [{ id, left: { indicatorId, params, outputField }, operator, right: { type: 'value', value } | { type: 'indicator', indicator } | { type: 'range', min, max } }] }]. Use list_indicators for indicator ids, params and output fields. The screener shape from run_screen ({ id, indicatorId, params, operator, value }) is accepted too and converted.

entry_trigger.description: level (default): open a trade whenever the conditions hold and nothing is open — how the verification dry run trades. edge: once per false→true transition — how live alerts fire.

exchange.description: Exchange to fetch candles from (default binance)

group_logic.description: Logic between condition groups: AND or OR

name: backtest_strategy
